GOLD COAST / COMMERCIAL SERVICES

Car parks & external works

We assess defects in car parks, paved areas and external access routes, then plan the work around vehicles, deliveries and pedestrians. We define the repair area, surface build-up and drainage connections before selecting materials. Larger drainage redesign or structural work is identified separately in the scope.

What we can look after

  • Localised paving, concrete and surface repairs.
  • Bollards, wheel stops and agreed external fixtures.
  • Drainage defects and access-area improvements.

Planning the work

  1. We inspect the surface defects, falls and affected traffic routes.
  2. We confirm staging, materials, closure periods and delivery access.
  3. We check the repaired area and confirm when it can return to use.

Questions about this service

Can you repair one area while the rest of the car park stays in use?+

We assess the access layout, repair method and curing requirements with your manager. Where practical, we agree staged work zones and clear alternative routes before attendance.
